semantics.area_fit: transparent operational field-size fit, not agronomic suitability
semantics.bjuv_proximity: transparent monotone logistics proxy from straight-line distance to Bjuv
semantics.area_logistics: weighted operational score from AreaFit and BjuvProximity; not probability

area_fit.rationale: C9b supports a broad 5-12 ha sweet zone; decline outside is deliberately soft

bjuv_proximity.rationale: C9b supports monotone negative distance association; no hard 60 km veto

area_logistics.weight_policy: fixed transparent policy weights; not optimized on historical pea labels

ranking_policy: C8 candidate class A before B before C before D
then current_field_id ascending for deterministic ties
guardrails: C8 A/B/C/D classes are not redefined by C10
5-12 ha was observed post-hoc in C9/C9b, so AreaFit is an operational policy curve rather than an agronomic optimum
BjuvProximity uses straight-line distance and is not road travel time
AreaLogistik weights are fixed policy weights and are not label-optimized
historical-selection diagnostics produced after scoring must not be used to retune C10 v0a in the same analysis
contracts, irrigation/water risk and farmer-level machinery/management remain outside C10
